_help: Target: actor class to edit (empty = the pawn you control). PrimaryComponent: mesh whose bones are listed (empty = the Character's Mesh). Include/ExcludeComponents: mesh names. SameSkeletonOnly: also edit other meshes on the actor that share the primary mesh's skeleton. BodyGroups: remap Body tab sliders to this game's bones (names from Advanced > Bones, * wildcards allowed; [] hides a slider). MorphGroups: Body tab sliders for morph targets, e.g. {"Breasts": ["PBMBreasts*"]}. ExcludeMorphs: morph names to hide. Hook: pose hook values for this game's exe (UE 5.7, GOG build, found by the hook finder); delete the line if a game update breaks it.
